question.zh: A3C 的“异步”体现在哪里？

options.en: Multiple workers update shared parameters in parallel
options.zh: 多个工作智能体并行更新共享参数

options.en: It uses only one fixed action
options.zh: 它只使用一个固定动作

explanation.en: Multiple worker agents interact with separate environment copies and asynchronously update shared actor and critic parameters. Advantage estimates reduce variance by comparing observed returns with the critic baseline.
explanation.zh: 多个工作智能体与各自的环境副本交互，并异步更新共享的 actor 与 critic 参数。优势估计把观测回报与 critic 基线比较，从而降低方差。
